question: In the run of the experimental matrix with the highest incineration temperature, what gas velocity and P/Fe/Na ratio were used?
rendered:
According to the experimental matrix (Table 2), the run with the highest incineration temperature was at 900 °C. 

For the run at 900 °C, the gas velocity was 1.3× Umf, and the P/Fe/Na ratio was 0.4/3/1.
